data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one 1024x1024 clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet with exactly 4 equal cells arranged as invisible 2 rows x 2 columns. Entire background must be solid flat magenta #FF00FF across whole sheet, including spacing and margins. No visible grid lines, no borders, no guide marks, no labels, no text, no numbers, no UI, no watermark, no checkerboard. Use the provided Noah nautilus avatar only as visual reference for palette and material language: glossy deep ocean blue, electric cyan, turquoise glow, violet rim light, pearl bubbles, polished clean-HD rendering. This is an attack effect sheet only: do NOT draw Noah, no body, no nautilus creature, no face, no eyes, no tentacles, no fins, no full shell body, no character silhouette, no card UI, no weapon, no hand. Use only abstract nautilus spiral glyphs, shell-curve energy, compressed water ribbons, bubbles, luminous pressure-wave shapes.

Keep each frame centered within its 512x512 cell with same visual scale and similar bounding box, generous magenta margin on every side, no effect element crossing or touching cell edges. Project-native clean HD 2D game FX, crisp silhouette, smooth hand-painted glow, glossy underwater fantasy lighting, high contrast cyan/turquoise/deep blue/violet palette, not pixel art.

Attack FX concept: “Noah spiral pressure breach,” a compact magical water-pressure attack released from a nautilus shell spiral, strong attack but cute, bright, aquatic, readable at game size. Avoid decorative shell illustration or full flower vortex.

Top-left frame 1 wind-up: at center of top-left cell, a small bright cyan abstract nautilus spiral core forming, two short deep-blue crescent strokes curling inward, violet shell-rim sparks, tiny pearl bubbles pulled toward core.

Top-right frame 2 release: at center of top-right cell, spiral snaps into diagonal shell-pressure slash from lower-left toward upper-right, bright aqua-white crescent blade, compact spiral core at base, thin turquoise water streaks, violet rim light, few compressed bubbles trailing behind.

Bottom-left frame 3 hit peak: at center of bottom-left cell, brightest frame, compact aqua-white impact bloom opens around diagonal slash, partial circular pressure ring, broken shell-curve shards, short curved water slashes, star-like glints, burst bubbles.

Bottom-right frame 4 dissolve: at center of bottom-right cell, slash breaks into translucent blue-violet crescent afterimages, scattered pearl bubbles, faint spiral ripple, clean readable footprint.

Exactly four FX frames only; preserve pure FX asset style; solid #FF00FF background.
